Shipyard.name: LVHI Adder
Shipyard.description: A small maneuverable shuttle designed for mining. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

Shipyard.name: UAC Ambition
Shipyard.description: Declassified gas production and distribution platform seized in a hostile takeover of an Atmosian conglomerate. For the ultimate insurgent.

Shipyard.name: NC Barge
Shipyard.description: A medium shipping vessel repurposed in a salvage and material exploitation vessel.

Shipyard.name: BB Baroness
Shipyard.description: A small luxury cruiser for one or two people, with a lounge, a private bedroom, and a hell of a cockpit view.

Shipyard.name: SLI Bazaar
Shipyard.description: The Bazaar is a personal service vessel designed to provide a platform for merchants to sell their goods, it features two locking cargo docks, a spacious cargo hold, and a mercenary post for shop security.

Shipyard.name: NC Bocadillo
Shipyard.description: A tiny food truck perfect for a solo chef. Better with a friend!

Shipyard.name: BB Bodkin
Shipyard.description: The smaller sibling to the Broadhead, the BB Bodkin is designed for rockhopping and salvage recovery.

Shipyard.name: BB Bookworm
Shipyard.description: A cozy medium-size library for travellers who wish to relax with a book or perhaps a board game.

Shipyard.name: KL Bulker
Shipyard.description: A medium mining vessel designed for deep space missions

Shipyard.name: SSS Camper
Shipyard.description: A personal camper shuttle for those who prefer to live in emptiness of space.

Shipyard.name: BB Ceres
Shipyard.description: A medium-size, high-class restaurant ship with ample seating, integrated botany and a dining room for VIP guests

Shipyard.name: ICR Chisel
Shipyard.description: Standard small-size vessel, originally meant to aid in ship scrapping, now modified to function as a multipurpose salvage/mining/cargo-hauling shuttle.

Shipyard.name: NT Comet
Shipyard.description: A mining and construction vessel intended to help build or repair quickly.

Shipyard.name: LVHI Copperhead
Shipyard.description: Copperhead is an affordable, versatile, small shuttle with room for customization optimized for mining and salvage missions. Whether operating within a fleet or autonomously, its design is a compromise between speed, which is important for medium- to long-distance travel, and maneuverability, which is crucial for navigating asteroid fields. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

Shipyard.name: FSB Courier
Shipyard.description: A compact cargo ship designed for hauling shipments.

Shipyard.name: KC Crescent
Shipyard.description: The Crescent, named for its exterior shape, is a vessel focused on providing service, medical aide, and scientific breakthroughs for smaller vessels.

Shipyard.name: PHI Crossroads
Shipyard.description: A spacious and inviting service ship. The crossroads is designed to help with dock crowding, connect communities, and serve as anchors for gatherings.

Shipyard.name: HS Garden
Shipyard.description: A small botany vessel dedicated to horiticultural experimentation.

Shipyard.name: LVHI Gasbender
Shipyard.description: The Gasbender is a medium-sized engineering vessel outfitted for deep space construction projects. Features atmospherics setup with mixing/ignition chamber. Designed to work in pair with smaller salvage ship. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

Shipyard.name: BB Hammer
Shipyard.description: A mobile engineering platform for deep-space repairs, upgrades and remodelling.

Shipyard.name: NC Hauler
Shipyard.description: A medium sized vessel specializing in long-haul salvage, mining, and cargo operations.

Shipyard.name: NT Honker
Shipyard.description: HONK HONK HONK HONK HONK HONK

Shipyard.name: NR Investigator
Shipyard.description: A medium research shuttle designed for xenoarcheological studies.

Shipyard.name: SSS Izakaya
Shipyard.description: A medium-size, japanese-inspired restaurant/pub ship with a large dining area, and equally large kitchen.

Shipyard.name: NC Kestrel
Shipyard.description: Once a local shipping lane freighter, this model has been converted for use in debris field mining and salvage operations.

Shipyard.name: LVHI Kilderkin
Shipyard.description: Spaceworthy bar/microbrewery with everything one needs to facilitate poor life choices: lots of booze, smokes, and lack of food. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

Shipyard.name: LVHI Legman
Shipyard.description: A small maneuverable shuttle with low operational costs for reporters who want to be first on a scene. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

Shipyard.name: LVHI Liquidator
Shipyard.description: A small shipbreaker/salvage vessel equipped with everything a small crew need for extended work shift in deep space. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

Shipyard.name: NC Loader
Shipyard.description: A compact cargo ship designed for hauling shipments.

Shipyard.name: BB Lyrae
Shipyard.description: A medium size science vessel with laboratories for both anomalous and xenoarchaeology research.

Shipyard.name: DC McCargo
Shipyard.description: Your very own McCargo™ franchise! Comes fully stocked and ready for production of McMeals.

Shipyard.name: FSB Nightlight
Shipyard.description: The Far Star Biotech company's premier catering and service shuttle! Legally NOT a testbed for nutrient sequencing and biogenerative pattern research on humanoid physiology!

Shipyard.name: WSE Nook
Shipyard.description: A ship designed as a mobile home, with space for user modifications. Fast and comfortable.

Shipyard.name: NR Phoenix
Shipyard.description: A research and salvage vessel designed for deep space exploration.

Shipyard.name: NC Piecrust
Shipyard.description: A combination animal ranch and pie bakery

Shipyard.name: NC Placebo
Shipyard.description: A small psychology vessel. Named after the famous Placebo effect.

Shipyard.name: NC Prospector
Shipyard.description: A small mining vessel designed to assist salvage operations.

Shipyard.name: NC Personal Transport
Shipyard.description: A small transport shuttle with space for 4 passengers. Comes with the latest audio entertainment technology.

Shipyard.name: FSB Pulsar
Shipyard.description: The Pulsar offers two robust polar work sites built around object retrieval and research circling a command hub. With a focus on safety, know that any catastrophic failures are entirely the fault of the operator! Brought to you by the Far Star Biotech corporation.

Shipyard.name: FSB Retort
Shipyard.description: A medium engineering vessel designed and deployed by the Far Star Biotech corporation to provide infrastructure support for deep space operations.

Shipyard.name: NC Skipper
Shipyard.description: A small service ship with a full service kitchen and hydroponics garden.

Shipyard.name: NR Spectre
Shipyard.description: A large, attractive but dated vessel with a pure focus on research and development. It is capable of generating anomalies.

Shipyard.name: NT Stellaris
Shipyard.description: A mobile theatre perfect for putting on any show.

Shipyard.name: FSB Surveyor
Shipyard.description: A budget mining and recovery shuttle for corporations unwilling to operate outside of a shoestring budget. Brought to you by the Far Star Biotech corporation!

Shipyard.name: NT Vagabond
Shipyard.description: A adaptable long-haul industrial freighter that pilots have adapted to many different purposes.

Medical.name: UW Akupara
Medical.description: A medium full-feature botanical research biodome equipped to help a botanist fully interact with their plants in almost any way conceivable.

Medical.name: FSB Apothecary
Medical.description: A small medical and chemistry support vessel. Deployed by the Far Star Biotech company to provide aid and medical services to the Frontier.

Medical.name: FSB Caladrius
Medical.description: A medical carrier produced by the Far Star Biotech corporation. Designed for large scale colonization support, humanitarian relief and post-disaster investigation and recovery operations.

Medical.name: FSB Druid
Medical.description: A medium service vessel providing botanical and chemical services to support the needs of the Frontier. Designed, developed and deployed by the Far Star Biotech company to render aid wherever it is needed.

Medical.name: NM Eagle
Medical.description: A modern, medium-sized engineering & medical vessel. Focused on responding to shuttle distress, the Eagle comes equipped to restore most crew and shuttles to good health.

Medical.name: LVHI Searchlight
Medical.description: A small vessel outfitted for the search and recovery of wounded NT personnel. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

Medical.name: FSB Spirit
Medical.description: The FSB Spirit is a search and rescue shuttle for experienced Frontier medics.

Medical.name: FSB Stasis
Medical.description: A medium medical vessel providing cryogenic and support medical services for the traumas of deep space operations. Designed, developed and deployed by the Far Star Biotech company to render aid wherever it is needed.

Medical.name: BB Tyne
Medical.description: A small, agile lifeboat with an exterior deck and survivor cabin for search and rescue operations.

Medical.name: CTC Vitalis
Medical.description: A medium medical support vessel designed for cryogenic deployment.

BlackMarket.name: Bocakillo

BlackMarket.name: Falcon
BlackMarket.description: Rebuilt mining vessel made into a pirate ship with hangar bay to store vehicles, fits between 3-4 crew.

BlackMarket.name: Menace
BlackMarket.description: Mail is no longer an option: you either receive it or you die.

BlackMarket.name: Schooner
BlackMarket.description: A small wooden ship with 2 central cargo bays.

BlackMarket.name: Turncoat
BlackMarket.description: A mercenaries pride and joy, repurposed at illicit shipyards for nefarious ends. Suited to a crew of 4.

Expedition.name: KC Anchor
Expedition.description: A large luxury cruiser capable of long ranged travel acrossed the sector, expedition capable.

Expedition.name: LVHI Brigand
Expedition.description: Civilian conversion of an old military light frigate from the early days of humanity's expansion to the stars, predating FTL technology. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

Expedition.name: EIS Charon
Expedition.description: Originally built as a roll-on, roll-off transport for heavy terraforming equipment. Since its obsolescence and appearance on the secondary market, the Charon has become a favorite of upfitters for the broad possibilities afforded by its open equipment bay. A product of Endurance Industrial Shipyards.

Expedition.name: DYS Dragonfly
Expedition.description: Highly modular salvaging vessel welded together from smaller re-purposed hulls.

Expedition.name: KC Pathfinder
Expedition.description: Once a scout ship serving with the Nanotrasen Marine Expeditionary Forces, this now decommissioned expedition capable ship can be yours!

Expedition.name: KC Sprinter
Expedition.description: A light freighter often picked by bounty hunters due to its quick acceleration, expedition capable.

Custom.name: DC McDelivery
Custom.description: Fast food fast ship, bring the McCargo meals to the people

Custom.name: NSF Cleric
Custom.description: Micro support vessel used for emergency rescues and first aid.

Custom.name: NSF Fighter

Custom.name: NSF Rogue

Security.name: NSF Broadhead

Security.name: NSF Empress
Security.description: A large patrol vessel capable of carrying up to 4 smaller faster attack ships. The flagship vessel of the NFSD.

Security.name: NSF Heimdall
Security.description: A small detective runabout for intelligence gathering and forensic work.

Security.name: NSF Hospitaller
Security.description: A small security medical craft designed for emergency response and search and rescue operations.

Security.name: NSF Hypnos

Security.name: NSF Paladin
Security.description: A small security assault craft designed for space combat equipped with an EXP-2100g mounted grenade launcher.

Security.name: NSF Prowler
Security.description: A medium-sized patrol craft, the Prowler class is a dedicated deep space pursuit vessel with an advanced sensor suite.

Security.name: NSF Templar
Security.description: A small security assault craft designed for combat interdiction operations.

Security.name: NSF Wasp
Security.description: A large expedition oriented ship for holding prisoners and making them work planetside.

Scrap.name: UAC Canister

Scrap.name: NT Construct
Scrap.description: A technically spacefaring vessel.  No livery.

Scrap.name: NSV Disciple
Scrap.description: A cheaply made amalgamation of religious ships. For the seasoned religious assistant.

Scrap.name: CLU Geode
Scrap.description: Built into a rock by the finest goblin engineers, this vessel has all the discrete trader needs to conduct business.

Scrap.name: SV Orange

Scrap.name: SV Tide

Sr.name: FSB Express
Sr.description: A small endurance shuttle for express logistics support in Frontier space.

Sr.name: LVHI Harbormaster
Sr.description: A small tugboat. Manufactured by Langstad-Voigt Heavy Industries.

Sr.name: NC Mail Pod
Sr.description: A cramped yet reliable shuttle for delivering packages.

Sr.name: NC Parcel

Sr.description: A refurbished and repainted older model of the NSF Templar for use for Mercenaries and 'repurposed' for the Station Guard, mind the gap.

Syndicate.name: Hunter
